entries.name: Resourceful

entries.name: Skillful

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries: Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

entries.name: Stonecunning
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you gain {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB}. The stone can be natural or worked.

You can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Elven Lineage
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait.

entries.caption: Elven Lineages
rows: You know the {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} cantrip. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace that cantrip with a different {@filter cantrip from the Wizard spell list|spells|level=0|class=Wizard}.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Insight|XPHB}, {@skill Perception|XPHB}, or {@skill Survival|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Trance
entries: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

items.name: Elven Lineage (High Elf)
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. You know the {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} cantrip. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace that cantrip with a different {@filter cantrip from the Wizard spell list|spells|level=0|class=Wizard}.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

entries.name: Naturally Stealthy

subclass.name: Path of the Dune Wanderer
subclassFeatures: Path of the Dune Wanderer|Barbarian|XPHB|Dune Wanderer|AGtM|3

subclassFeature.name: Path of the Dune Wanderer
entries: {@i Rage like the Desert Storm}

Barbarians who walk the Path of the Dune Wanderer live on the edge of civilization and the endless dunes. You have learned to survive the harshest of the desert. Your rage channels the violence of the dunes.

entries.subclassFeature: Rage of the Desert Storm|Barbarian|XPHB|Dune Wanderer|AGtM|3

subclassFeature.name: Resilience of the Dunes
entries: You have learned to survive on the worst of conditions. You only ever need to consume food and water for a tiny sized creature no matter your size.

subclassFeature.name: Rage of the Desert Storm
entries: While your rage is active you gain a blindsight up to 30 feet. A sandstorm gathers around you any creature within a 30 feet emanation from you must succeed a con save DC 8 + prof + con mod and on a fail is {@condition blinded}.

subclassFeature.name: Shifting Sands
entries: While you are raging you move with the sand. You can reduce all damage you take by your strength modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Speed of the Sands
entries: Whenever you take damage while raging you can use your reaction to teleport anywhere within your sandstorm.

subclassFeature.name: Rage of the Sandstorm
entries: Your sandstorm increases to 60 feet now whenever a creature fails the con save they take an amount of d6's equal to your rage damage.

subclassFeature.name: College of Assassins
entries: {@i The not so silent death}
Bards of College of Assassins use the fact that they are welcome near many people of power to remove obstacles to their goals or remove enemies of the highest bidder.

subclassFeature.name: Distracted Death
entries: Gain proficiency with poisoners kit. You add your charisma modifier to sleight of hand rolls. As a bonus action you can roll a deception or performance check against a creatures insight if you succeed on the creature you gain advantage on that creature for the next minute or until you use this feature again.

subclassFeature.name: Killing Blow
entries: If you have advantage on an attack roll and roll a sleight of hand above the targets AC you can roll your Bardic die twice and add it to the damage.

subclassFeature.name: Silent Casting
entries: When you cast a spell you can expend a use of your bardic to ignore all components for the spell or you can cast that spell as a bonus action. If the spell has an attack roll you add the bardic die to the attack roll. If the spell has a saving throw and targets a single creature you can subtract a roll of the bardic die from the roll.

subclassFeature.name: Bardic Poison
entries: On your turn as a bonus action you can expend a bardic inspiration die to coat your blade or ammunition in poison. A creature that takes Piercing or Slashing damage from the poisoned weapon or ammunition takes an extra four rolls of your bardic die as poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.

subclassFeature.name: Order of Fallindriea
entries: {@i The mistress of magic has blessed you}
The magic domain focuses on the Arcane and the mysteries of the goddess of magic. Clerics who tap into this domain wield magic in a new way.

entries.name: Magic Domain Spells
entries: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Life Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Life Domain Spells
rows: {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB}, {@spell Mirror Missile|XPHB}, {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}

entries.name: Mistress of Magic
entries: Your goddess lets you alter your magic as you cast it. Whenever you cast a spell you can choose to.
Alter Elements If the spell deals Fire, Poison, Lightning, Thunder, Force, Radiant, Necrotic, Acid, Psychic, or Poison damage you can change the type to any of those.
Alter Save You can change the type of save the creature must make for the spell.
Save the faithful You can choose up to wisdom mod creatures to automatically succeed the saving throw.

entries.name: Channel Divine Mage
entries: As a magic action you present your holy symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to cast a spell. When you cast a spell in this way it is upcast to your highest spell slot.

subclassFeature.name: Holy Speed
entries: When you cast a spell you can use a bonus action to cast a cantrip.

subclassFeature.name: Divine Concentration
entries: Your goddess has expanded your mind. You are able to concentrate on wisdom modifier (min 1) spells at once. You only ever roll concentration for one spell at time.
